newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - CARMEL, IND..

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF INTENT TO SELL
County Option Income Tax Lease Rental Revenue Bonds of 1997
On behalf of the City of Carmel Redevelopment Authority (the Authority') will receive sealed proposals at the offices of H.J. Umbaugh &Associates. Certified Public

at 1:00 pm or prior to September 15, 1997 and upon not les than twenty-four (24) hours notice given by telephone, facsimile or otherwise and shall consider each proposal for the purchase of the Bonds. The Bonds are special and limited obligations of the Authority, payable as to principal and interest solely from and secured solely by certain property pledged pursuant to a Trust Indenture, between the Authority and a trustee (the Trustee''), including semi-annual lease rental payments to be paid by the City of Carmel
Authority, pursuant to a Lease Agreement.
The Bonds will mature semi-annually on January 1 and July 1 in the following amounts:
Maturity Date Principal Amount Maturity Date Principal
The Authority reserves the right to adjust principal amounts within maturities to achieve approximate level debt service based upon the rates by by the successful bidder.

The Bonds maturing on or after January 1, 2007, may be redeemed prior to maturity at the option of the Authority in whole or in part, in any order of maturity as selected by the Authority and by lot within maturities, on any date not
earlier than July 1, 2006 as described more fully in Official Statement.

Each bid must be accompanied by a certified or cashier's check or a financial surety bond in the amount of $320,000, payable to City of Carmel Redevelopment Authority. financial surety bond may be used, as described more fully in the Notice of Intent to Sale.

Further information relative to said issue, and a copy of the near final Official Statement may be obtained upon application to Ms. Colette J. Irwin-Knott, H.J. Umbaugh &Associates, Certified Public Accountants, LLP, Suite 100, 20 East 91st Street, Indianapolis, Indiana 46204, telephone: (317) 844-7288 fax: (317) 848-3604, financial advisors to the Authority.
